gdacs-cyclone-tc-1001347.summary: Typhoon Cempaka (JMA No. 32) began on 6 November 2026 near the Mariana Islands. It passed over waters south of Japan's Ogasawara Islands, where Ogasawara Village issued storm and high wave warnings. Sources report it dissipated or became an extratropical cyclone around 11–12 November. No damage, casualties or evacuations are reported in the sources reviewed.

gdacs-cyclone-tc-1001351.summary: Tropical Cyclone Akvan was listed by an automated alert feed as starting on 16 November 2026 over the Bay of Bengal, near India, with a centre at 13.1 N, 87.3 E and peak winds of 93 km/h. A headline, unverified, says it may become a severe cyclonic storm by 19 November. No news, government or relief reports could be checked, so no impacts are confirmed.

gdacs-drought-dr-1018332.summary: Drought in Europe, which started on 21 December 2025, is ongoing across much of the continent. Rhine water levels reached a record low at the Kaub gauge on 12 August 2026, and the Golfech nuclear plant in France shut down on 9 July because of river temperature. Rainfall in October and November improved soil moisture in many regions, while drought worsened in the Iberian Peninsula in early November. The GDACS feed was last updated on 24 November 2026.

gdacs-drought-dr-1023877.summary: A drought in Northern South America and the Panama Isthmus, starting 21 September 2022, is listed in a GDACS alert feed, last updated 23 November 2026. The feed gives an area of about 1,683,760 km² and a severity of significant. Official reports and current conditions could not be confirmed, and no affected places or impacts were verified.

gdacs-drought-dr-1027449.summary: Drought has affected Central America since March 2026, according to a Copernicus report; the feed dates it from 21 April 2026. By 16 September, Honduras had 233 of 298 municipalities under drought alerts, 103 of them under red alert. Guatemala declared red alert in 15 Trifinio municipalities on 21 September, and food distribution began in mid-November. El Salvador declared a nationwide red alert on 25 August. As of 20 November 2026, the drought is ongoing.

Preliminary local assessments reported no casualties and no collapsed buildings. Emergency inspections in surrounding areas were continuing as of 22 November.

ifrc-earthquake-8055.summary: A magnitude 7.4 earthquake struck San José del Palmar, Chocó, Colombia, on 10 August 2026. Colombia's national disaster agency (UNGRD) reported 329 dead, 4,600 injured and 247 missing in its tally cut off on 22 August, with damage in 16 departments. Landslides blocked the town's only land route. The sources found do not confirm the current state of the response.

ifrc-earthquake-8060.summary: On 15 August 2026, a magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck Nagekeo Regency in East Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia. BNPB reported 105 deaths, 1,678 injuries and 179,037 displaced as of 25 August. Aftershocks continued, and 188,161 people remained at evacuation centers on 30 August, with evacuee numbers falling. The latest report found is dated 1 September 2026.

ifrc-flood-8025.summary: A flash flood hit Nuristan Province in eastern Afghanistan on 20 July 2026, with Parun, the provincial capital, among the worst affected. UN News reported at least 26 deaths across eastern Afghanistan, including 23 in Nuristan, and an initial report gave over 100 people missing in Parun. The latest dated report found is from late July 2026, and the current status is not reported.

ifrc-flood-8050.summary: Monsoon flooding in Myanmar started around 12 August 2026 and affected about 600,000 people, including communities in Sagaing, Rakhine, Ayeyarwady and Kachin, according to UNICEF's end-August brief. Reports in August cited at least one death and more than 11,400 people moved to relief centres in Sagaing. The latest flood-specific update found is dated 8 September 2026. No source confirms the flooding continued after September.

ifrc-flood-8073.summary: On 26 August 2026, a flash flood on the Bhote Koshi river hit Rasuwa district in Nepal's Bagmati Province, damaging settlements, roads, bridges and hydropower projects. Areas downstream in Nuwakot, Dhading and Chitwan were also affected. Sources give conflicting death tolls. The latest update found, dated 13 September 2026, reported search and rescue and relief still under way. No later status was found.
